name: MiniSphere: Panoramic Image Viewer
summary:
• Designed for intuitive 360° panoramic image viewing presentations, including first-time headset users

• Local image loading from the Download (Quest 3 > Internal shared storage > Download) folder — images can be downloaded directly through the Quest browser or transferred via USB connection 

• Supports up to 7 panoramic images.

• Filename-based image sorting — rename your images to create your preferred viewing sequence. Recommended format: 01_Filename, 02_Filename, 03_Filename.

• Controller-free navi
